title: Low-Cost Multi-touch Whiteboard using the Wiimote
summary: Johnny Chung Lee shows how infrared light pens and a Wii Remote can make a very low-cost multi-point interactive whiteboard or tablet display. Software is available for download.
why: HN cites it as a clever low-budget hardware hack and as an example of novel Wiimote uses that never became commercial.
